title: RUN INFO TEXT IS THE LABEL SIZE
why: UI step 4, the HUD in play. The run info panel (conditions, contracts, goals) was drawn at the 13 px micro size, below the 16 px floor of the style guide, and was the densest block on the screen. It is drawn at the label size now, in a slightly wider and taller row, so the same contracts wrap the same way. Every contract is still shown (his v6.79).
now: Run info text is bigger and easier to read.

edits.anchor:
ctx.font=FS(TYPE.micro);
    var pad=8, lh=LH(11), bw=Math.round(LH(165)), inner=bw-pad*2;
edits.replacement:
ctx.font=FS(TYPE.label);   // v28.xx (cw-runinfo16), UI step 4 (style guide: 16 px floor for anything read): the run info panel was the micro size (13 px), a wall of small print
    var pad=8, lh=LH(13), bw=Math.round(LH(196)), inner=bw-pad*2;   // v28.xx (cw-runinfo16): and a little wider and taller in the row so the bigger text wraps no more than before
